title: Concept: Full counterparty account number in a response
description: A counterparty account field holding a long digit string in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Payment APIs echo the counterparty account back to the browser, and a full account number plus the IFSC is enough to raise a mandate or a collect request against the payer.
applicability: Deployments that render a counterparty account field holding a long digit string into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Payment APIs echo the counterparty account back to the browser, and a full account number plus the IFSC is enough to raise a mandate or a collect request against the payer.
